---
title: "Sites"
page-layout: full
---

Click a marker to see the site's metadata and a link to its page.

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false
library(leaflet)
source("r/utils.R")

# --- read the data -----------------------------------------------------------
sites <- read.csv("data/sites.csv", colClasses = "character",
                  strip.white = TRUE, fileEncoding = "UTF-8-BOM")
required <- c("lon", "lat", "site", "nb_control", "nb_logged", "plot_size")
stopifnot("sites.csv is missing required column(s)" = all(required %in% names(sites)))

sites$lon <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(sites$lon))
sites$lat <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(sites$lat))
bad <- is.na(sites$lon) | is.na(sites$lat) | sites$site == ""
if (any(bad)) warning("Skipping ", sum(bad), " row(s) without valid site/lon/lat")
sites <- sites[!bad, ]

# --- helpers -----------------------------------------------------------------
# must give the same result as slugify() in scripts/generate_sites.py
slugify <- function(x) {
  x <- stringi::stri_trans_general(x, "Any-Lower; NFD; [:Nonspacing Mark:] Remove")
  x <- gsub("[^a-z0-9]+", "-", x)
  x <- gsub("^-+|-+$", "", x)
  ifelse(x == "", "site", x)
}
esc <- htmltools::htmlEscape

popup <- paste0(
  "<div class='site-popup'><h4>", esc(sites$site), "</h4>",
  "<table>",
  "<tr><th>Plot size (ha)</th><td>", esc(sites$plot_size),  "</td></tr>",
  "<tr><th>Number of logged plots</th><td>", esc(sites$nb_logged),  "</td></tr>",
  "<tr><th>Number of control plots</th><td>", esc(sites$nb_control), "</td></tr>",
  "</table>",
  "<a href='sites/", slugify(sites$site), ".html'>Open site page &rarr;</a></div>"
)

# --- map ---------------------------------------------------------------------
m <- leaflet(sites, width = "100%", height = "75vh") |>
  addProviderTiles(providers$OpenStreetMap) |>
  addCircleMarkers(
    lng = ~lon, lat = ~lat,
    radius = 9, weight = 2, color = "#14532d",
    fillColor = "#22c55e", fillOpacity = 0.85,
    label = ~site, popup = popup
  )

if (nrow(sites) == 1) {
  m <- setView(m, lng = sites$lon, lat = sites$lat, zoom = 8)
} else if (nrow(sites) > 1) {
  m <- fitBounds(m, min(sites$lon), min(sites$lat), max(sites$lon), max(sites$lat))
}
m
```

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| results: asis
# List of all sites, one section per continent, in the order of sites.csv
all_sites <- read.csv("data/sites.csv")

for (cont in unique(all_sites$continent)) {
  s <- all_sites[all_sites$continent == cont, ]
  cat("\n\n## ", md_escape(cont), "\n\n", sep = "")
  cat(paste0("- [", md_escape(s$site), "](sites/", slugify(s$site), ".html)"), sep = "\n")
  cat("\n")
}
```
